positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
·	Implemented new endpoint handlers and middleware for vaccine processing and validation.
·	Ensured data from schemas were exposed in a HIPAA compliant manner for analysis through Looker. 
·	Collaborated across multiple teams in architecting new service infrastructure as well as reviewing and editing design documents and pull requests.
·	Created and updated integration and unit automated tests to ensure backwards compatibility and response accuracy.
·	Initialized and modified PostgreSQL schemas using Alembic, an automated migration tool.
·	Reduced application downtime by using Grafana logs to troubleshoot client and server HTTP error responses.
·	 Composed and integrated requests to athenahealth API, an EHR (electronic health record)

positions.title: DevOps Junior Engineer
positions.description:
· Maintain a client facing application with a microservice architecture by creating and running CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins.  
· Automate build and deploy of provisioned AWS resources using internal tools integrated with AWS CloudFormation.
· Add and support Kinesis Data Firehose Delivery Stream compatibility with internal provisioning tool. 
· Program and test AuroraDB compatibility for open-source software Maskopy using an AWS SDK for Python and its object-oriented API.
· Migrate application configurations to a decentralized architecture and drastically reduce micro-application configuration overrides.
· Create and update Docker images used in application deployment pipelines.

positions.description: Accepted into emerging talent program with direct placement as a DevOps Junior Developer for FINRA.
